# observe.logs

Single-shot read of a log source; returns per-pattern match counts + sample lines

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `container` | string | No | - |
| `journal_unit` | string | No | - |
| `max_bytes` | integer | No | - |
| `max_lines` | integer | No | - |
| `path` | string | No | - |
| `patterns` | array | **Yes** | - |
| `sample_lines` | integer | No | - |
| `since` | string | No | - |

## Platform Support

linux, darwin, windows, freebsd
